questions.prompt: If P(Y ∩ Z) = 0.24 and P(Y) = 0.36, find P(Y | Z) assuming that Y and Z are mutually exhaustive of the sample space.
questions.explanation: If Y and Z are exhaustive, P(Z) = 1 − 0.36 + 0.24 = 0.88 and P(Y | Z) = 0.24 / 0.88 = 0.273, which is not listed. 0.24 / 0.36 = 0.67 is P(Z | Y).

questions.reviewNote: The correct value is not among the options. The paper probably meant P(Z | Y) = 0.67. Needs the key.
